name: Dragon32 Complete ROM Sets
description: Serves Stock and Enahnced set of ROMs for the Dragon32 - lo and hi ROMs - when installed in the lo (IC18) socket
detail:
Instructions:
1. Install OneROM 24 in IC18 socket
2. Connect ROM IC17 socket CS pin (20) to SDRR pin X1 on the OneROM.
3. Use jumper on bank A of OneROM to select enhanced rom set, jumper off for stock.

rom_sets.description: Stock Dragon32 ROM set taken and split from https://colorcomputerarchive.com/repo/ROMs/XRoar/Dragon/BASIC_OS/d32.rom
Enhanced Dragon32 ROM set taken from https://colorcomputerarchive.com/repo/ROMs/XRoar/Dragon/BASIC_OS/D32_&_D64_ENHANCED_ROMs_v3/REAL_DRAGON/D32/

notes: Use jumper on bank A of OneROM to select enhanced rom set, jumper off for stock.
